_comment: Sample: overriding Defense in Depth settings from the server config. Merge the gameProperties.missionHeader block into your real config (e.g. cfg/did_lamentin.json). Anything left out keeps what the scenario .conf says; anything the .conf leaves out keeps what the world was authored with.

missionHeader._comment_autostart: Without this the match waits on the setup screen until an admin presses Start. Set it to true on a server nobody attends: the match then starts by itself when the first player has joined, with the sides and timings below.
missionHeader._comment_sides: Which side config each side plays. Omit both to keep what the game mode prefab names.
